mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS meal_id, m.meal_type, m.meal_date, mi.food_id AS food_id, mi.quantity, f.name AS food_name, f.brand, f.serving_size, f.serving_unit, f.calories, f.carbohydrate, f.protein, f.fat FROM meals m LEFT JOIN meal_items mi ON mi.meal_id = m.id LEFT JOIN foods f ON f.id = mi.food_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.meal_date = #{date} ORDER BY CASE m.meal_type WHEN 'BREAKFAST' THEN 1 WHEN 'LUNCH' THEN 2 WHEN 'DINNER' THEN 3 WHEN 'SNACK' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, f.name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(f.calories, 0) * mi.quantity), 0) FROM meals m JOIN meal_items mi ON mi.meal_id = m.id JOIN foods f ON f.id = mi.food_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.meal_date = #{date}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(f.calories, 0) * mi.quantity), 0) AS calories, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(f.carbohydrate, 0) * mi.quantity), 0) AS carbohydrate, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(f.protein, 0) * mi.quantity), 0) AS protein, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(f.fat, 0) * mi.quantity), 0) AS fat FROM meals m JOIN meal_items mi ON mi.meal_id = m.id JOIN foods f ON f.id = mi.food_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.meal_date = #{date}

SELECT m.id AS meal_id, m.meal_type, m.meal_date, mi.food_id AS food_id, mi.quantity, f.name AS food_name, f.brand, f.serving_size, f.serving_unit, f.calories, f.carbohydrate, f.protein, f.fat FROM meals m LEFT JOIN meal_items mi ON mi.meal_id = m.id LEFT JOIN foods f ON f.id = mi.food_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.meal_date >= #{startDate} AND m.meal_date < #{endDate} ORDER BY m.meal_date, CASE m.meal_type WHEN 'BREAKFAST' THEN 1 WHEN 'LUNCH' THEN 2 WHEN 'DINNER' THEN 3 WHEN 'SNACK' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, f.name
INSERT INTO meals (user_id, meal_type, meal_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mealType}, #{mealDate}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_items (meal_id, food_id, quantity) VALUES (#{mealId}, #{item.foodId}, #{item.quantity})

if.foreach: ( name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{token.value}, '%') OR COALESCE(brand, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{token.value}, '%') OR REGEXP_REPLACE(name, '\s+', '', 'g') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{token.compactValue}, '%') OR REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(brand, ''), '\s+', '', 'g') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{token.compactValue}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT source_key FROM foods
GROUP BY source_key ) matched_food_groups

SELECT source_key FROM foods
GROUP BY source_key ORDER BY CASE WHEN MIN(name) = #{query} THEN 0 WHEN MIN(name) ILIKE CONCAT(#{query}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN MIN(COALESCE(brand, '')) = #{query} THEN 2 WHEN MIN(COALESCE(brand, '')) ILIKE CONCAT(#{query}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, CASE WHEN #{query} = '' THEN 1 WHEN MIN(COALESCE(brand, '')) ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN MIN(COALESCE(brand, '')) = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, LENGTH(MIN(name)), MIN(name), MIN(COALESCE(brand, '')), source_key LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id AS food_id, source_key, name AS food_name, brand, serving_description, serving_size, serving_unit, calories, carbohydrate, protein, fat FROM foods WHERE
( name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{token.value}, '%') OR COALESCE(brand, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{token.value}, '%') OR REGEXP_REPLACE(name, '\s+', '', 'g') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{token.compactValue}, '%') OR REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(brand, ''), '\s+', '', 'g') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{token.compactValue}, '%') )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN name = #{query} THEN 0 WHEN name ILIKE CONCAT(#{query}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(brand, '') = #{query} THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(brand, '') ILIKE CONCAT(#{query}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(brand, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(brand, '') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, LENGTH(name), name, brand
